topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Apartment building goin' condo, huh? Didn't see that one comin' 'round the corner. Leases, they say, get tossed in the wind like yesterday's newspaper. Folks around here, they start talkin' funny, all smiles and whispers, like they know somethin' the rest of us don't. I’ve been around the block enough times to know when the ground’s shiftin' under your feet. Gonna have to take a long, hard look at the fine print, peel back the layers. Money talks in this town, and the echo's gettin' louder. Ain't nothin' for free, and somebody’s goin' down unless you play your cards right. Time to dig in, keep your eyes open, and your back against the wall.
